import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Try to find a link or button for Configurations to navigate to the configurations section
    try:
        config_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Configurations", exact=False)
        await config_link.click()
    except:
        try:
            config_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Configurations", exact=False)
            await config_button.click()
        except:
            # If no Configurations element found, click Add Attribute as a fallback to potentially access configurations
            add_attribute_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add Attribute")
            await add_attribute_button.click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
    return "Attempted to navigate to configurations section"
